close_reason: Added Hash to pkix-ct::Error derive list. All four variants are unit-variant so Hash is mechanical; matches the workspace baseline (Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash) used by other structurally-Hashable error enums (e.g., pkix-path-builder::Error).
description:
## Anchor
PKIX-qwzx (pass 2) commit message claims: 'Inconsistent Error derives reconciled across 8 Error types'. The reconciliation chose Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq as the workspace baseline and added Hash only where all variants permit it (pkix-path-builder::Error derives Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash).

## Finding
pkix-ct::Error (pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:57) is declared as:

```
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[non_exhaustive]
pub enum Error {
    NoScts,
    NoTrustedSct,
    InvalidSignature,
    ParseError,
}
```

All four variants are unit variants — no inner data. The type is trivially Hash-able. pkix-path-builder::Error (also all-unit-variant) was given the Hash derive in pass-2; pkix-ct::Error was missed.

## Why other Error types legitimately can't derive Hash
Verified by inspection:
- pkix-path::Error::Der(DerError(der::Error)) — der::Error derives only Copy, Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq (no Hash). Cannot propagate Hash.
- pkix-revocation::Error::{CrlParseError, OcspParseError}(DerError) — same.
- pkix-chain::Error::{Path, Revocation} — wrap the above; cannot.
- pkix-chain-simple::Error::Path(PathError) — wraps pkix-path::Error; cannot.
- pkix-ac::Error::AaPathInvalid(pkix_path::Error) — same.
- pkix-revocation-http::FetchError::Transport(Box<dyn Error>) — documented exception (no Clone/PartialEq/Eq either).

So pkix-ct::Error is the only error type in the workspace that is structurally Hashable but does not derive Hash.

## Severity
P3 (idiom / consistency). Hash on Error enums is useful for users who want to dedupe errors by variant identity (e.g., 'collect distinct errors from a batch validation'). Adding a derive is non-breaking under #[non_exhaustive].

## Fix
Add Hash to the derive list:
```
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
```
No other changes needed; all variants are unit.
title: (IDIOM) P3: pkix-ct::Error misses Hash derive that pass-2 reconciliation should have added
